_note: Mock test run: run_halfpipe=false uses mock_derivatives from each site's data.json. Set run_halfpipe=true to invoke HALFpipe on real data; the site's data directory (set in the NeuroFLAME UI) is used as the BIDS root.

files._note: Register the Schaefer atlas as a ref file so the atlas_based_connectivity feature can use it.
NeuroMark fMRI 1.0 parcellation (53 ICs, 7 domains). Baked into the image at build time.

features._note: Atlas-based connectivity: extracts per-parcel BOLD time series and computes the full covariance and correlation matrix. Requires the atlas ref file above.
features.name: connectivity

features._note: NeuroMark connectivity: 53x53 FC matrix across ICA-derived functional network regions.

roi_extraction._note: Schaefer 2018 200-parcel 17-network atlas in MNI152NLin2009cAsym 2mm space. Must be available at this path inside each site's container when run_halfpipe=true.
